intro: Ursolan is a sprawling Timbermaw furbolg settlement situated in western Azshara, just east of Timbermaw Hold. Bisected by a deep ravine, the encampment honors the bear Ancient Ursol and serves as a vital stronghold for uncorrupted furbolgs defending their territory from outside incursions.

p: Perched on the rugged bluffs of western Azshara, Ursolan constitutes the eastern branch of the Timbermaw tribe's domain, connecting directly through Timbermaw Hold to Bear's Head in the south. Named after the revered bear Ancient Ursol, this camp represents a rare haven of sanity among Kalimdor's furbolg populations, which have largely fallen victim to demonic corruption. The village spans both rims of a dramatic earthen chasm, where the Timbermaw vigilantly guard their borders against encroaching interlopers, including intrusive researchers from the night elven camp of Talrendis.
